channel.title: Latest | FOCUS TAIWAN - CNA ENGLISH NEWS
channel.description: As Taiwan's national news agency, Focus Taiwan (focustaiwan.tw) to provide real-time news related to Taiwan to the English-reading public at home and abroad.

image.title: Latest | FOCUS TAIWAN - CNA ENGLISH NEWS

item.title: Taiwan to vie for U-18 Asian Baseball Championship bronze medal
item.description: Taipei, Sept. 12 (CNA) Taiwan is set to face the Philippines in the U-18 Asian Baseball Championship third-place playoff following a 2-1 loss to Japan on Saturday.

item.title: 400th foreign high-level expert naturalized as ROC citizen since 2016
item.description: Taipei, Sept. 12 (CNA) A total of 400 foreign "high-level" professionals have been naturalized as Republic of China (Taiwan) citizens over the past decade as the government has eased nationality rules to attract talent from a wider range of fields, the Ministry of the Interior said Saturday.

item.title: CPC to raise domestic gasoline, diesel prices next week
item.description: Taipei, Sept. 12 (CNA) State-owned oil supplier CPC Corp., Taiwan announced Saturday that it will raise domestic gasoline prices by NT$0.7 (US$0.02) per liter and diesel prices by NT$0.6 per liter next week after international crude oil prices rose above US$100 per barrel this week.

item.title: Taiwan temple culture showcased in Poland
item.description: Lodz, Poland, Sept. 12 (CNA) Taiwan's traditional temple culture was showcased in the Polish city of Lodz on Friday, drawing crowds with traditional music, deity processions, performances and a Taiwan-themed market.

item.title: Central bank under pressure to raise rates at upcoming meeting: Economists
item.description: Taipei, Sept. 12 (CNA) With domestic inflation topping the 2 percent alert level for a fourth consecutive month in August and several major central banks around the world raising their key interest rates, Taiwan's central bank is facing growing pressure to raise rates at its quarterly policymaking meeting scheduled for Thursday, economists said.

item.title: Amending constitution won't solve Taiwan's political deadlock: Panel
item.description: Taipei, Sept. 12 (CNA) Amending the Constitution is not the answer to Taiwan's political deadlock over disputed legislation and judicial appointments, panelists at a Taipei seminar said Saturday, calling instead for dialogue between the ruling and opposition parties.

item.title: Taiwan to be featured country at 2026 IF Illustration Festival in Lyon
item.description: Paris, Sept. 12 (CNA) The IF Illustration Festival, hosted by French illustration magazine Kiblind, will feature Taiwan as its theme country on Sept. 26-27 in Lyon, France.

item.title: New iPhones sell out 2 minutes after preorders open: Vendor
item.description: Taipei, Sept. 12 (CNA) Apple's latest iPhones -- the iPhone 18 Pro series and the iPhone Duo, the first foldable iPhone -- sold out within two minutes of preorders opening Thursday afternoon, Chunghwa Telecom Co., one of Taiwan's major telecom operators, said late Friday night.

item.title: Parts of northern Taiwan under heavy rain advisories: CWA
item.description: Taipei, Sept. 12 (CNA) The Central Weather Administration (CWA) on Saturday issued heavy rain advisories for Taipei and New Taipei, and announced an extremely heavy rain advisory for Yilan County.

item.title: Culture minister says Taiwan's existence is a 'mirror' that reveals China
item.description: Paris, Sept. 12 (CNA) Taiwan's Minister of Culture Li Yuan (李遠) said in a radio interview in France that Taiwan's existence and culture were painful for China, describing Taiwan as "a mirror that reveals the true nature of things."

item.title: Taiwan has right to make friends despite Chinese pressure: VP Hsiao
item.description: Ventotene, Italy, Sept. 11 (CNA) Taiwan has the same right as others to make friends and work with like-minded partners despite Beijing's efforts to restrict its international presence, Vice President Hsiao Bi-khim (蕭美琴) said on Friday.

item.title: Seasonal winds ease, western Taiwan highs to hit 34°C Saturday
item.description: Taipei, Sept. 11 (CNA) As seasonal northeasterly winds are forecast to weaken, daytime temperatures in western Taiwan are expected to reach as high as 34 degrees Celsius on Saturday, according to the Central Weather Administration (CWA).

item.title: Beijing has no right to interfere in vice president's visit to Italy: MOFA
item.description: Taipei, Sept. 11 (CNA) Taiwan's Ministry of Foreign Affairs (MOFA) pushed back Friday against Beijing's criticism of Vice President Hsiao Bi-khim's (蕭美琴) ongoing visit to Italy, saying China has no right to interfere in the trip.

item.title: Man critically injured in fire at Taitung air base
item.description: Taipei, Sept. 11 (CNA) A contractor fell into a 12-meter-deep oil tank at Chihhang Air Base in Taitung County and suffered severe burns after a fire broke out while he was handling residual oil Friday afternoon, according to the county's Fire Department.

item.title: CSBC partners with Havoc on autonomous surface vessel development
item.description: Taipei, Sept. 11 (CNA) CSBC Corp., Taiwan's largest shipbuilder, announced Friday that it has teamed up with U.S.-based all-domain collaborative autonomy firm Havoc to develop autonomous surface vessels (ASVs) in Taiwan.

item.title: Malaysian men sentenced to 9 years for smuggling heroin into Taiwan
item.description: Kaohsiung, Sept. 11 (CNA) Two Malaysian men who concealed 26 packets of heroin in their rectums to smuggle the drugs into Taiwan in exchange for US$1,250 each were each sentenced to nine years in prison, the Kaohsiung District Court said Friday.

item.title: Taiwan shares tumble on Fed rate hike fears
item.description: Taipei, Sept. 11 (CNA) Shares in Taiwan moved sharply lower by more than 750 points Friday, led by the electronics sector, amid growing fears over an interest rate hike by the U.S. Federal Reserve after Washington reported the fastest monthly growth in the producer price index in August since May and international crude oil prices surged, dealers said.

item.title: NSC adviser urges caution on travel to China amid new rules
item.description: Taipei, Sept. 11 (CNA) Alex Huang (黃重諺), an adviser to the Presidential Office's National Security Council (NSC), renewed warnings Friday against traveling to China ahead of new entry-exit regulations set to take effect there next Tuesday.

item.title: Taiwan Academy to bring cultural events to Houston in the Fall
item.description: Washington, Sept. 10 (CNA) The Taiwan Academy in Houston is set to host a series of arts and cultural events this fall, featuring award-winning films from Taiwan and more modern performances that showcase Taiwan's gender identity and equality values.

item.title: Taiwan to review minimum wage Sept. 24, expected to top NT$30,000
item.description: Taipei, Sept. 11 (CNA) The Ministry of Labor (MOL) is set to review next year's minimum wage on Sept. 24, with the monthly rate expected to exceed NT$30,000 (US$948) after the government expressed support for an increase.

item.title: U.S. dollar closes higher on Taipei forex market
item.description: Taipei, Sept. 11 (CNA) The U.S. dollar rose against the Taiwan dollar Friday, gaining NT$0.090 to close at NT$31.638.

item.title: Micron to give employees rewards worth 35-68 months' pay
item.description: Taipei, Sept. 11 (CNA) U.S.-based memory chip supplier Micron Technology Inc. said Friday it will distribute rewards equivalent to 35-68 months' pay to its workers in Taiwan for fiscal 2026 as the company's union in the country has threatened to strike.

item.title: President promulgates act to boost defense autonomy, drone industry
item.description: Taipei, Sept. 11 (CNA) The Office of the President on Friday issued a presidential order promulgating an act aimed at strengthening Taiwan's defense autonomy and developing its unmanned vehicle industry, after Premier Cho Jung-tai (卓榮泰) countersigned the legislation.

item.title: Taiwan shares close down 1.61%
item.description: Taipei, Sept. 11 (CNA) Taiwan shares ended down 755.64 points, or 1.61 percent, at 46,184.85 Friday on turnover of NT$721.91 billion (US$22.84 billion).

item.title: 1996 election showed Taiwanese choose their own leaders: Ex-president
item.description: Taipei, Sept. 11 (CNA) Taiwan's first direct presidential election in 1996 was a defining moment in its transition to democracy and a declaration to the world that its people would choose their leaders and future, former President Tsai Ing-wen (蔡英文) said Friday.

item.title: Vice President Hsiao Bi-khim in Italy for democracy forum
item.description: Taipei, Sept. 11 (CNA) Vice President Hsiao Bi-khim (蕭美琴) is visiting Italy to attend an international conference on freedom and democracy, the Ministry of Foreign Affairs (MOFA) said Friday, confirming a previously unannounced trip.

item.title: U.S. dollar up in Taipei trading
item.description: Taipei, Sept. 11 (CNA) The U.S. dollar was traded at NT$31.618 at 10 a.m. Friday on the Taipei Foreign Exchange, up NT$0.070 from the previous close.

item.title: Taiwan shares open lower
item.description: Taipei, Sept. 11 (CNA) The Taiwan Stock Exchange's main index opened down 289.28 points at 46,651.21 Friday on turnover of NT$10.98 billion (US$347.59 million).
